dataset.name: P18 Intent and Safety Benchmark
dataset.description: Versioned, human-labeled holdout benchmark expanded deterministically from distinct intent, ambiguity, unsupported, malformed, and adversarial prompts. Prefix/suffix contexts are fixed and documented; examples are not used to train the classifier.

confidence_reliability.note: Empirical calibration on this fixed benchmark only; model confidence is not assumed to be a calibrated probability.

escalation.note: UNKNOWN is scored as a classification label; escalation is reported separately from class accuracy.

recovery_probe.scenario: One controlled malformed classifier result, checker feedback, then retry with the local demo classifier.

performance.api_cost_note: No verified provider pricing configuration is available; cost is not estimated.

checker_recovery_probe.scenario: One controlled malformed classifier result, checker feedback, then retry with the local demo classifier.

normal_vs_checker_recovery.note: The controlled recovery request uses the same selected provider after one injected local parse failure; this single fault-injection sample is descriptive, not a significance or improvement claim.

memory_comparison.reason: The project has no retrieval or memory module to evaluate.

checker_disabled_baseline.reason: Disabling the checker would bypass a safety control and is not benchmarked.

comparative_analysis.provider_comparison_note: No stored run from another provider uses this exact dataset version and SHA-256.

limitations: This is a fixed, locally authored benchmark with deterministic context variants, not a representative production sample.
Demo-provider scores characterize keyword heuristics and are not estimates of real-world semantic accuracy.
Real-provider runs require explicit provider selection and may consume billable quota; no real-provider run is implied by demo results.
No pricing is configured, so API cost is intentionally null.
Memory-based classification is unavailable in this project; no memory benefit is claimed.
The controlled checker retry probe is fault injection, not a randomized reliability estimate.
